Job Purpose:
To ensure the timely, cost-effective, and efficient procurement of materials, goods, and services required by the organization through effective sourcing, supplier management, inventory monitoring, and contract negotiation.

Minimum 5 years experience in Procurement.

Reliable, honest and can listen to instructions.
Effective communication skills.
SAP knowledge would be an advantage.

Location: Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
Company: Centre for Armed Violence Reduction (CAVR)
Employment Type: Contractor, to 31 December 2027

About the Company
The Centre for Armed Violence Reduction (CAVR) is a charity that provides a range of systems and services to reduce violence in PNG, from tribal fighting to prison riot prevention. We pride ourselves on achieving results, innovative solutions, and working effectively with clients and stakeholders. We provide our systems and services in countries all around the world. 27361.description:
Job Type:
Fixed Term Contract
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining the project construction team and reporting to the Registered Mine Surveyor, the primary purpose of this position is providing support in all survey activities, including surface and underground across the organization.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Do Daily face pick-up and mark-up, update of working plans/computer files.
Practical use of the Surpac software including Leica total stations and GPS units, UAV drones etc.
Undertaking a variety of surveys including engineering, construction, and roads.
Undertaking mining and exploration surveys in both open cut and underground.
Collaborating with project staff and seeking advice from Senior Surveyors as required.
Deliver project outcomes in accordance with client specifications and expectations.
Commitment to application of work health and safety principals’ policy.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have a tertiary qualification in Surveying with MRA Mine Surveyor accreditation, along with experience in either the Mining, Construction, Engineering or Oil and Gas industries. In addition to this you will have some or all the following.
Sound communication skills.
Bachelor’s degree in surveying
MRA Mine Surveyor accreditation preferred.
Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Topography Survey, preferable in the mining industry.
Sound knowledge in regulatory requirements (with respect to Land Use and land Rights/ Acquisition) by the Mining Regulatory Board
Surpac software experience.
Sound knowledge of safe mining practices and mining standards
Strong planning and analytical skills.
A team player with good computer skills.
Able to communicate effectively across all levels.
Minimum of a Class one (1) driver’s license.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

27776.description:
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.
About Lihir
Lihir is one of the world's largest gold mining operations, located on Niolam Island in Papua New Guinea's New Ireland Province. The operation is renowned for its unique volcanic landscape and combines world-class mining and processing with a strong commitment to safety, sustainability,  innovation and technical excellence.
The operation combines open-pit mining and gold processing in a remote island setting, supported by modern facilities and a culture focused on improving daily.
At Lihir, you'll be part of a team that is deeply connected to the island and the communities that call it home. We are committed to creating lasting benefits through local employment, training, scholarships and apprenticeship programs, while fostering a workplace where people look out for one another and succeed together.
With a culture grounded in safety, respect and delivering responsibly, Lihir offers the opportunity to develop your career while contributing to an operation that plays an important role in Papua New Guinea's economic and social development.
Your Impact
As our Advisor People, Training (Safety), you will play a vital role in building a safer, more capable workforce across site operations. You will empower employees through engaging training programs, practical coaching, and competency assessments that support regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and a strong safety culture. Your expertise will directly contribute to developing people, improving workforce capability, and ensuring every team member is equipped to work safely and effectively.
As part of our team, you will
Design, deliver, and continuously improve safety training programs aligned with company, industry, and regulatory standards.
Facilitate both classroom-based and practical on-the-job training across a range of operational areas.
Conduct competency assessments and field observations to identify skill gaps and development opportunities.
Partner closely with supervisors, superintendents, business partners, contractors, and operational teams to understand business needs and develop targeted training solutions.
Drive and influence proactive safety behaviours that support a positive workplace culture.
Develop and maintain training materials, learning resources, and competency frameworks.
Accurately manage training records and compliance data within the Learning Management System (LMS).
Contribute to workforce capability planning through gap analysis and training plan development.
Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the workforce.
Support site-wide compliance objectives and contribute to the ongoing development of training standards and practices.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
To thrive in this position, you will bring a combination of technical expertise, strong facilitation skills, and a passion for developing people.
Essential qualifications and experience:
•    Certificate IV in Training & Assessment (TAE40122 or equivalent).
•    First Aid certification and relevant OHS qualifications.
•    Minimum 5 years' experience within an industrial, mining, or heavy industry environment.
•    Experience delivering safety-focused training and competency assessments.
•    Strong understanding of adult learning principles, training methodologies, and competency frameworks.
•    Proven ability to facilitate engaging training sessions and coach individuals in operational environments.
•    Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and learning management systems.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•    PNG Class 6 and Class 3 Driver's Licence (or ability to obtain relevant site requirements).
Highly regarded experience:
•    Mining industry experience.
•    Confined Space Awareness and Controller/Tester qualifications.
•    Working at Heights training experience.
•    Light Vehicle, Light Truck, Traffic Control, and Load Restraint training expertise.
Key personal attributes:
•    Open-minded and receptive to constructive feedback.
•    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
•    Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.
•    Collaborative, approachable, and committed to building strong relationships.
•    Passionate about safety, learning, and helping others succeed.
Your work environment
Based at our Lihir operation, you will join a supportive team dedicated to developing people and promoting a strong safety-first culture. You will work alongside operational leaders, health and safety professionals, contractors, and site personnel, building trusted partnerships across the business.
This is an environment where collaboration is valued, continuous improvement is encouraged, and your contribution to workforce development will have a visible impact. You'll have the opportunity to expand your capabilities, be supported in achieving additional qualifications, and develop your career toward future leadership opportunities.
Working Conditions
This role is offered on a 21:21 Fly in, Fly out (FIFO) roster to Lihir Island, Papua New Guinea
Our FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, in an en-suited and airconditioned room equipped with mini fridge, TV and Wi-Fi. A variety of healthy meal options are catered for at our mess; and the wet mess provides a relaxed social setting where employees can unwind with a game of pool or darts.
At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.​

27827.description:
About Newmont
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.
About Lihir
Our Lihir operation is located on Aniolam Island in Papua New Guinea’s New Ireland Province. Lihir is one of the world’s largest producing gold operations and is situated within a geothermally active, extinct volcanic crater near the town of Londolovit. As a major open-pit gold operation, Lihir plays an important role in Newmont’s global portfolio and contributes significant economic and social value to Papua New Guinea and local communities.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your role
As the Geochemist – Geothermal, you will support the Mine Geothermal Team and broader Mine Technical Services group by delivering geochemical monitoring, analysis and interpretation across geothermal operations. Your work will help manage geothermal risk, optimise well performance and support safe, sustainable geothermal operations at Lihir.
This is a hands-on technical role suited to someone with strong analytical capability, a safety-first mindset and the ability to work collaboratively across geoscience, reservoir, operations and technical teams.
Key Responsibilities
-- Deliver accurate and timely geochemical sampling, analysis and interpretation of geothermal fluids, including steam, brine, condensate and gases.
-- Support geothermal well testing programs by analysing geochemical data to assess feed zones, reservoir conditions and well performance.
-- Contribute to geothermal risk identification and management through interpretation of fluid chemistry trends and field observations.
-- Plan and execute geochemical sampling and fieldwork safely, considering thermal hazards, gas exposure, chemical handling requirements and operational constraints.
-- Ensure personnel, visitors and contractors comply with site and geothermal-specific health, safety and environmental requirements.
-- Develop and communicate geochemical insights to support weekly and monthly geothermal and mine planning activities.
-- Provide guidance and training to technical and operational personnel in geothermal geochemistry, sampling techniques and hazard awareness.
-- Identify opportunities to optimise sampling programs, improve data quality and manage laboratory and consumable costs effectively.
Your Skills & Experience
-- Tertiary qualification in Geochemistry, Chemistry, Geology or a related discipline.
-- PNG Driver’s Licence.
-- Strong understanding of geothermal fluid sampling techniques, QA/QC protocols and laboratory data interpretation.
-- Knowledge of scaling, corrosion and gas chemistry processes in geothermal systems.
-- Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.
-- Proficiency in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
-- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and data management systems for reporting and analysis.
-- Ability to work safely and effectively in a field-based operational environment.
-- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical information clearly.
Desirable experience includes a postgraduate qualification in Geochemistry or Geothermal Science, experience in geothermal, mining or hydrothermal systems, geothermal well testing and fluid chemistry interpretation, exposure to geothermal or geotechnical monitoring systems, and experience using geochemical modelling tools.
Work Environment & Benefits
This is a full-time role based at Newmont’s Lihir operation in Papua New Guinea, working on a 21 days on / 21 days off day shift roster. You will work within Mine Technical Services, supporting the Mine Geothermal function as part of a collaborative technical team focused on safe geothermal operations, practical field execution, continuous improvement and responsible resource management.
Why Join Newmont
At Newmont, our people are our strength, and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining. Learn more about our purpose and values: About Newmont Hear from our people: Life at Newmont Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team:
[email protected]
.
Apply

27766.description:
Looking for a Change?
Join CARE International in PNG and be part of an organisation that serves the needs of Papua New Guineans living in remote PNG.
EXTERNAL RECRUITMENT
Project Coordinator – Peacebuilding Project
CARE International in PNG is seeking a qualified and experienced Project Coordinator to support the effective coordination and implementation of the Peacebuilding Program. CARE International in PNG aims to continue its work in Peace Building in the upper Highlands. CARE works directly with community members, local civil society organizations, community leaders, and local authorities to implement community-driven conflict prevention activities in Enga province across 8 communities. Key activities include educating communities about the benefits of peace and how to achieve it, training of village court magistrates and community police on conflict mitigation and conducting community needs analysis in a participatory way. This includes pro-active inclusion of women.
This position will report to the Program Manager who is based in Goroka. The main responsibilities of the position are: 1. Establish and maintain close working relationships with key stakeholders, including government and other development partners on the ground. 2. Work with local communities to review and provide technical support to their Community Peace for Development Plans 3. Coordinate with relevant Enga Provincial Government stakeholders such as; Department of Agriculture and Livestock to monitor progress of the community small grants projects, Department of Law and Justice; Village Court Services, etc. 4. Coach and provide technical support to the Executives of the community-based Cooperatives 5. Monitoring and mentoring support for the registered cooperatives, women led CBOs, youths’ groups and CSOs directly involved in peacebuilding advocacy.
This role is based in Wabag with frequent travels to the communities selected in Enga province. S/he will direct line supervise few officers.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Community Development and/or, Peace building, Humanitarian or other related fields and/or minimum 4- 5 years relevant work experience in community development preferably with an International Non-Government Organisation (INGO) and/or private company;
Demonstrated experience in following standard policies, procedures and processes and ensure the implementation of basic standard transactions including the management and acquittal of cash advance;
Proven experience in report writing and donor submissions;
A willingness to learn about CARE, gender equality and women’s empowerment activities;
Demonstrated good interpersonal skills, sound judgment, planning, problem solving and team building skills;
Demonstrated organisational and time management skills, working in a team and the ability to work under pressure and to organise and manage workload to meet deadlines;
Demonstrated characteristics in honesty, reliability, trustworthiness with the ability to maintain confidentiality;
Demonstrated ability to contributes to group objectives and work effectively in a group setting;
Representational skills including developing networks and relationships with key stakeholders;
Demonstrated ability to represent the organisation with high level external audiences;
Fluent oral and written communication skills in both Pidgin and English; and
Fully conversant in Microsoft Office with knowledge in Microsoft Word, Power Point and
CORE COMPETENCIES
Good facilitation, communication, community mobilisation and interpersonal skills
Ability to work respectfully and effectively with diverse community members, including women, young people, older people and people with disabilities
Good organisational skills and ability to support field activity planning, logistics and documentation.
Ability to work as part of a team and follow agreed workplans, procedures and reporting requirements
Ability to travel and work in rural and remote communities, including under challenging field conditions
Commitment to CARE’s values, safeguarding standards, gender equality, inclusion and accountability to communities
The closing date for this position is Monday 27
th
July 2026

email:

CARE PNG is committed to safeguarding children and the Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse.
CARE PNG does not tolerate gender-based violence and is committed to ensuring that Women, Men, Girls, and Boys live a LIFE FREE FROM VIOLENCE

27470.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role you will assist the Raisebore Driller with the safe and efficient setup, operation, and maintenance of raise drilling activities while maintaining a safe working environment.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Assist with moving, handling, and setting up drill rods for raise drilling operations.
Support the Raisebore Driller in daily drilling tasks and operational requirements.
Monitor drilling activities and assist as required to ensure safe and efficient operation.
Conduct pre-start checks and greasing of the raise drill.
Clean, inspect, and grease drill rod threads to maintain equipment integrity.
Monitor and operate the 90kW pump used for drilling fluids.
Clean and maintain the drill rig, associated equipment, and surrounding work area.
Operate Light Vehicles (LV) in underground environments.
Operate Telehandler equipment where required.
Operate Volvo IT120 (forks and basket) in accordance with site procedures.
Use basic hand tools safely and effectively.
Maintain high standards of housekeeping in all work areas.
Follow all site safety procedures and instructions.
Work collaboratively as part of a team to achieve operational goals.
About You
It is requirement of the position that the incumbent possesses the following.
Valid driver’s licence (suitable for site requirements)
Ability to work in a physically demanding environment
Machinery operation tickets (LV, Telehandler, IT Loader)
Previous underground or mining experience.
Grade 12 Level education.
Strong safety awareness and commitment to safe work practices.
Ability to perform manual labour tasks consistently and safely.
Capability to follow instructions and implement them correctly.
Good teamwork and communication skills.
Basic mechanical aptitude and familiarity with hand tools.
Ability to perform duties with minimum supervision.
Able to communicate effectively at all levels.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

Dispatch Operator
Simberi Gold Company Limited forms part of the St Barbara Group. Our Simberi Operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Our vision is to grow sustainably and create enduring, positive impacts for the people and communities touched by our operations.
Now is an exciting time for our business and for our people. We’re going through a period of significant change and are gaining momentum in transforming our business. We’re looking for people who are ready to grow through opportunity and build a bright future with us.​​
We are currently seeking a
Dispatch Operator
to join our Mining team on a permanent full-time position at our Simberi Operation. Your work location is Papua New Guinea, working a 14/7 Roster from Kavieng, Rabaul, Port Moresby, Lae, Mt Hagen, Buka, Madang, Goroka, Alotau, Wapenamanda, Popondetta, Hoskins, Wewak, Vanimo, or Tabar group of Islands.
(
Locals are encouraged to apply)
.
Reporting to the Senior Dispatch Engineer, this position is responsible for facilitating daily mine plan execution in the safest, most efficient manner, while always being mindful of continuous improvement opportunities. This will be accomplished using a IVMS System.
The opportunity
Technical Accountabilities
Ensuring the efficient use of the truck haulage fleet by constant monitoring, adjustments to Dispatch optimization algorithms and manual interventions, as required.
Issuing clear and concise work instructions to Load and Haul operators.
Providing process advice to line leaders to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.
Ensuring material movement priorities are executed as per the Mine Engineering Daily Plan.
Working closely with the Mine Operations Data Analyst, to continuously update shift production data and conditions to ensure an extremely high level of accuracy in the data captured.
Working with Modular Mining and Anglo Performance Assurance teams to implement improvement opportunities.
Maintaining all mine model parameters (i.e., new roads, dumps, maps, etc.) to ensure the accurate function of the Dispatch system.
Liaising with Mine Maintenance personnel to ensure the efficient transfer of equipment to and from an operational state.
Liaising with Mine Technology Specialists to ensure timely and accurate reporting of system defects.
Holding Heavy Equipment Operators accountable for timely and accurate entries into the FMS.
Using systems to continuously monitor the Mine for hazards, then reporting and acting accordingly.
Facilitating the smooth and efficient transition between normal mining operations and shutdown states (i.e., shift changes, blasting, weather stoppages, industrial actions, etc.).
Providing detailed commentary and contextual information to daily shift reports to explain variations to plan.
Receiving emergency calls and acting according to Mining Emergency management plan; and
Working with Mine Operations and Engineering teams to assess and improve KPI’s.
Scheduling Accountabilities
Monitoring of all trucks or equipment’s for operational and technical teams regarding task and priority scheduling to optimise efficiency.
Ensuring that the Mining Department develops and uses effective plans that derive from and support the Company and site plans.
People Accountabilities
Ensuring staff resources are maximised and staff members undertake appropriate training and development, so they are skilled efficiently to perform allocated duties.
Providing direction and act as a technical reference point and mentor for staff while ensuring work outputs are in line with strategic and business plans.
Implementing and ongoing monitoring of performance and development review plans for all direct reports.
Initiating of any disciplinary action or reward recognition for staff under direct supervision within the work unit.
Promoting and adhere to Occupational Health and Safety Policy and Procedures through consistently demonstrating and encouraging safe work practices.
Identifying training requirements of subordinates through consultation with the employees and the Simberi Gold Company Training Department
Using established training methods and in conjunction with the Training Department train subordinates to achieve competency in the area identified and within the scope of their position
Are you ready to come and build your future with us?
We need the best people. People who have drive, energy and are genuinely passionate about the work they do and provide a positive impact. Additionally, we need people who see a challenge as an opportunity for growth and value working with others towards a common goal.​
We would love to hear from you if you have​:
Essential
Minimum of a Grade Twelve (12) academic completion
A minimum of two (2) years’ experience working in a Mining environment
Working experience of multiple shovel/drill/truck/track operations
Strong analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong skills with the Microsoft Office Suite of programs
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the specific ability to be clear and concise with radio communications
Conflict Management skills, including root cause identification of issues
Natural leadership skills, with the ability to informally coach and performance manage others
Possess a high level of self-motivation and passion for technology
Skilled at planning tasks, setting priorities, and altering priorities, using sound decision making
Excellent time management skills with the ability to multitask in a high-pressure environment; and
Proven commitment to Safety, Health, and Environmental Standards

27750.description:
Dewatering Specialist
Simberi Gold Company Limited forms part of the St Barbara Group. Our Simberi Operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Our vision is to grow sustainably and create enduring, positive impacts for the people and communities touched by our operations.
Now is an exciting time for our business and for our people. We’re going through a period of significant change and are gaining momentum in transforming our business. We’re looking for people who are ready to grow through opportunity and build a bright future with us.​​
We are currently seeking a
Dewatering Specialist
to join our Dewatering team on a permanent full-time position at our Simberi Operation. Your work location is Papua New Guinea, working a 21/14 Roster from Kavieng, Rabaul, Port Moresby, Lae, Mt Hagen, Buka, Madang, Goroka, Alotau, Wapenamanda, Popondetta, Hoskins, Wewak, Vanimo, or Tabar group of Islands.
(
Locals are encouraged to apply)
.
Reporting to the Mining Superintendent, the Dewatering Specialist is responsible for the planning, implementation, and optimization of water management systems to control groundwater and surface water at a mine site. The incumbent’s primary role involves ensuring the safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant dewatering operations to maintain mine stability, protect operational assets, and support production targets in compliance with industry safety standards and the Company’s safety and environment policy and procedures.
The opportunity
Technical Accountabilities
Design and Management of Dewatering Systems: Develop, implement, and monitor dewatering systems (pumps, pipelines, sumps) to control water inflow, reduce groundwater levels, and maintain dry conditions in mine pits and waste areas.
Operational Oversight: Coordinate daily dewatering operations, adjusting systems based on changing groundwater conditions or seasonal variances. Maintain continuous communication with mine operations teams to ensure dewatering aligns with operational needs.
Water Quality and Environmental Compliance: Ensure dewatering activities adhere to environmental regulations, water discharge permits, and safety standards. Monitor water quality, manage environmental impacts, and adjust dewatering strategies as needed.
Data Collection and Analysis: Collect and analyse hydrogeological data to evaluate groundwater levels, water flow rates, and efficiency of dewatering systems. Use data to identify trends, anticipate needs, and improve system performance.
Maintenance and Troubleshooting: Oversee the maintenance, repair, and replacement of dewatering equipment, ensuring maximum operational uptime and effectiveness. Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues to minimize disruptions.
Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with engineering, environmental, and operations teams, as well as external consultants, to support effective dewatering strategies. This collaboration includes participating in planning and budget discussions.
Reporting and Documentation: Generate detailed reports on dewatering system performance, maintenance activities, and compliance status. Document operational procedures, maintenance records, and water management plans.
Comply with established environmentally sustainable measures to not adversely impact on the natural fauna, flora, freshwater resources and marine life within the bounds of Simberi Island
Identify any potentially hazardous work/environmental situations and address these with the Mining Supervisor and Mining Engineer.
Scheduling accountabilities
Plan the daily activities accordingly that is in line with the weekly plan.
Coordinate dewatering activity with Supervisors.
Provide daily management and supervision to ensure that all incident recalls and toolbox meetings are done prior to commencement of daily activity on the mine pits.
Organise the duties of the dewatering personnel to ensure that they are carried out safely and satisfactorily.
People accountabilities
Ensure that subordinates have all undergone a thorough workplace induction prior to being actively involved in work routines at the dewatering areas on the mine pits.
Ensure that subordinates are properly trained and are well versed in dewatering procedures and standard work practices.
Provide direction and act as a technical reference point and mentor for subordinates.
Ensure compliance with all statutory and company standards through training and development of personnel and promoting such by example.
Be responsible for implementing and monitoring of performance and development review for all personnel within the work unit / direct subordinates.
Be accountable for the initiation of any disciplinary action or reward recognition for personnel under direct supervision within the work unit.
Provide coaching and training for subordinates (especially local employees) with a view to promoting their level of competency.
Identify training requirements of subordinates through consultation with the employees and recommend to supervisors.
Using established training methods and in conjunction with the Training Department train subordinates to achieve competency in the area identified and within the scope of their position.
Participate in training provided by the business.
Are you ready to come and build your future with us?
We need the best people. People who have drive, energy and are genuinely passionate about the work they do and provide a positive impact. Additionally, we need people who see a challenge as an opportunity for growth and value working with others towards a common goal.​
We would love to hear from you if you have​:
Essential
Behaviour consistent with St Barbara’s Values
Have a minimum of 5-10 years’ experience in Mine Dewatering
Competent in swiftly ramping up on site activities with efficient cross-function skills and ensuring on time completion
Well-developed communicator and a natural leader
Sound analysing and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively in a team environment with other staff members to achieve stated responsibilities and duties.
Effective communication and teamwork skills
Ability to plan work effectively and efficiently with a minimum of supervision and to set priorities
Ability to provide reports to mining supervisor/production superintendent
Punctual attendance for all rostered shifts
Prepared to accept responsibilities

27398.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our supply team, you will manage supplier performance and provide the timely expediting of purchasing and procurement of goods ensuring delivered on time according to specified quantity, quality and cost requirements and within the supply policy guidelines
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Expediting on the purchases and ensure that the quality of goods and materials purchased is to K92 Mining standards and specifications.
Ensure purchasing at the optimal price in relation to quality, quantity and delivery method.
Issue recommendation for Purchase Requisition that follow K92 Mining policies and standards have been met.
Ensure appropriate documentation is completed and filed for all transactions.
Manage the supplier base ensuring high level supplier performance, and cost management through regular contact with suppliers.
Review performance of key suppliers across KPIs including lead time compliance, delivery completeness & number of discrepancies
Investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities in the procure to pay process.
Investigate invoice discrepancies to ensure suppliers are paid in a timely manner.
Investigate PO and goods receipt discrepancies to ensure that goods are available on site to meet requirements
Recommend P2P process improvements in conjunction with systems enhancements
Ensure the timely completion of all expediting purchase requests.
Regular communication with internal customers to understand expectations and required timeframes when issuing purchase orders.
Follow up with suppliers to understand delays in quoting and seek alternative quotes as required
Ensure purchase requests are converted to purchase orders and issued to suppliers in a timely manner.
Manage out of hours purchase needs.
Monitor the delivery of goods and materials ensuring conformation that deliveries are completed to the K92 Mining schedules and plans.
Communicate with suppliers to ensure that specified delivery timeframes are met.
Seek alternative suppliers, or substitute products where emergency requirements or supplier failure may lead to goods not being available on site on the date required
Ensure Safety, Health and Environmental legislation is recognised in all purchasing activities.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have all or the following
Minimum 3 years’ experience in industry with relevant experience in transactional expediting purchasing
Understanding of ERP systems (Pronto) to support purchasing and expediting processes.
Negotiation skills and understanding of negotiation techniques.
Commercial analysis and evaluation.
Problem solving and decision-making capability.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience communicating with vendors in PNG and Internationally to expediting according to T&C’s for supply to K92
Ability to communicate clearly with people at all levels of the organisation and engage all relevant stakeholders.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

27837.description:
Mobile Maintenance Planner
Job Title
Senior Maintenance Planner
Location
Tolukuma Mine Site, Papua New Guinea (Underground Mine)
Department
Mobile Maintenance (M&E)
Roster
19 days on / 9 days off
Reports To
Superintendent - Mobile Maintenance
Company Overview
Tolu Minerals Limited has successfully completed its exploration phase and is transitioning into underground mining operations in Papua New Guinea, with full-scale production targeted for 2027. This role is part of the build-up of operational capability across the Mobile Maintenance Department as the company moves from development into full operational status.
Job Purpose
Reporting to the Mobile Maintenance Superintendent and Head of Mobile Maintenance the Senior Maintenance Planner is responsible for overseeing and developing, scheduling, and coordinating planned maintenance activities for Tolu Minerals' mobile equipment fleet. The role ensures maintenance work is properly planned, resourced, and sequenced to maximize equipment availability while minimizing disruption to operations, and maintains accurate maintenance records to support the transition to full-scale production in 2027 and beyond.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the team of junior planners and parts expeditors in successful maintenance planning, mentor and develop the teams skill sets.
Spend time in the field interacting with the production and maintenance workforce, ensuring the ongoing effectiveness of the planning/work management process.
Provide significant input into the development/review of maintenance strategies in consultation with Production, Maintenance and equipment OEM’s to ensure that PM’s and other maintenance activities will safely deliver the desired equipment performance – e.g. equipment availability/reliability targets
Review/update task PM’s and activities as part of ongoing continuous improvement ensuring all PM’s and activities have clear purpose in assessing component condition and preventing failures.
Ensure that all PM activities (labour, parts, tasks, costs, etc.) and schedules are uploaded and maintained in Pronto for system integrity.
Maintain a 2 - 12 week equipment planned maintenance schedule, make adjustments when necessary to optimise/maximise equipment availability and utilisation.
Ongoing management of the reference library and drawings.
Monitor equipment wear rates, and use this data to optimise timing/scheduling of tasks.
Catalogue spare parts and update stock levels when necessary to avoid stock-outs and ensure supply of parts and re-buildables as required. Update equipment Bill of Materials to maintain accuracy.
Execute the Maintenance Asset Management strategy as delivered by the Head of Maintenance
Ensure registers are regularly updated
In partnership with the Mobil Maintenance superintendent Provide regular backlog reports for` the Head of Mobile Maintenance with commentary.
Maintain and update the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) with work order history, equipment data, and maintenance records.
Liaise with the Warehouse/Procurement team to ensure spare parts and consumables are available ahead of scheduled maintenance.
Assist in the Analysis of equipment maintenance and failure history to identify trends and recommend improvements to maintenance strategy.
Assist in Supporting cost control by tracking maintenance labour hours, parts usage, and budget variance for the mobile fleet.
Participate in maintenance planning meetings and contribute to continuous improvement of maintenance processes and procedures.
Qualifications
Trade certificate in Diesel Fitting, Heavy Equipment Mechanics, or related mechanical/electrical discipline, or equivalent planning/scheduling qualification.
Certificate or diploma in Maintenance Planning, Engineering, or Asset Management preferred.
Current PNG driver's license.
Experience
Minimum 10 years' experience in a maintenance planning, scheduling, or coordination role within a mining or heavy industrial environment.
Prior trade background in mechanical or heavy equipment maintenance highly regarded.
Demonstrated experience using a CMMS (e.g. Pronto or similar, Microsoft) for work order and scheduling management.
Experience in an underground mining environment preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong organizational and scheduling skills with high attention to detail.
Proficiency in CMMS and Microsoft Office (Excel in particular) for planning and reporting.
Good understanding of preventive maintenance principles and mobile equipment maintenance requirements.
Strong communication and coordination skills across maintenance, operations, and supply chain teams.
Analytical mindset with ability to interpret maintenance data and identify trends.
Ability to work proactively and manage multiple competing priorities.
Working Conditions
Underground and surface mining environment with exposure to heat, humidity, noise, dust, and confined spaces.
Operates on a fixed roster of 19 days on / 9 days off.
Required to work shift patterns including day and night shift as rostered.
Must comply with all Tolu Minerals HSE policies, PNG Mining Safety regulations, and site-specific permit-to-work systems.
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is mandatory at all times in designated areas.
Acknowledgement
This job description outlines the general nature and key responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Duties may be amended from time to time in line with operational requirements as Tolu Minerals progresses toward full production.
How to Apply
If you have the skills, experience, and motivation to contribute to the continued success of Tolu Minerals, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining the position you are applying for to:
[email protected]
Application close on the 24/07/2026 @3pm
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not receive a response within two (2) weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful.
Apply

Fixed term contract up to 10 July 2028 (with possible extension)
Based in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
Open to PNG national candidates only
About Palladium
Palladium is a global leader in the design, development, and delivery of Positive Impact – the intentional creation of enduring social and economic value.  We work with governments, businesses, and investors to solve the world's most pressing challenges. With a team of more than 2,000 employees operating in 75-plus countries and a global network of over 35,000 experts, we help improve economies, societies, and, most importantly, people's lives.
About PNG-Australia Strongim Wok Long TVET (SWLT)
The PNG–Australia Strongim Wok Long Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) (SWLT) program is a four-year, AUD 80 million investment by the Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) to support Papua New Guinea’s (PNG) efforts to strengthen its TVET sector. Aligned with PNG’s national priority to build an educated and skilled workforce for resilient economic growth, SWLT aims to enhance the quality, relevance, and inclusiveness of skills development. The program supports improvements in national quality assurance systems, technical college standards, graduate employability, and Australia’s visible and trusted development partnership with PNG.
The program aligns with the broader goals of the
Australia–PNG Development Partnership Plan 2024–2029
, which emphasises locally led development, education investment, and inclusive growth, as well as
PNG’s Higher and Technical Education Reform Act 2020
.
This Opportunity
As
Senior Monitoring, Evaluation, Research & Learning Manager
you will be responsible for leading and managing the implementation, delivery and continuous improvement of SWLT’s MERL system, framework and associated activities. The role has overall responsibility for ensuring the program generates, analyses and uses high-quality monitoring, evaluation, research and learning evidence to support adaptive management, accountability and reporting requirements.
This will include:
Lead the implementation, management and continuous improvement of the SWLT MERL Framework, MERL Plan and associated systems, tools and processes.
Ensure the effective collection, analysis, quality assurance and use of monitoring, evaluation, research and learning data across all areas of program delivery.
Manage the day-to-day operation of the MERL function and ensure MERL activities are delivered in accordance with approved workplans, budgets and reporting requirements.
Lead and supervise the MERL team, including work planning, performance management, professional development and quality assurance of all MERL outputs.

Foster a supportive team culture within the MERL team, including the proactively management of Senior MERL Coordinators.

Manage scholarship application processes, assessments, interviews, implement student selection criteria and clear scoring matrices and ensure alignment with priority skill quotas.
Manage the scholarship disbursement budget, approve tuition payments to TVET colleges, and ensure zero-error financial tracking.

27522.description:
We are Hiring!
CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (CFO)
Location: Lae, Papua New Guinea
We’re looking for an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join our executive team in Lae and help drive the next phase of business performance, operational improvement, and sustainable growth.
This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role in an asset-intensive, operationally complex business—ideal for a commercially astute finance leader who enjoys strategy, execution, and strong stakeholder engagement. Success in this role will require a practical approach and the ability to work closely with operational teams to improve financial performance, asset utilisation, cash generation, systems, and business processes.
The Opportunity
As CFO, you will partner closely with the CEO and executive team to strengthen financial performance, optimise capital, improve systems, and support smart growth. You’ll lead the finance function while influencing key commercial decisions across fleet operations, port activities, and major contracts.
Critically, you will be the primary contact point for Bismark Maritime’s financiers—leading relationships, reporting, and negotiations to ensure ongoing support and access to capital.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and execute the company’s financial strategy aligned to business objectives
Oversee financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and performance analysis
Drive strong cash flow, liquidity, and capital management across fleet/port operations
Serve as the primary relationship lead and point of contact for banks and financiers, including covenant management, reporting, facility negotiations, and funding strategy
Build and manage relationships with insurers, investors, and key commercial partners
Lead enterprise risk management, insurance strategy and financial governance frameworks.
Lead commercial support for major negotiations (suppliers, vendors, insurance, contracts)
Evaluate investment opportunities, asset initiatives, and risk/return trade-offs
Ensure tax, regulatory, statutory, and corporate compliance in PNG
Lead Environmental, Social and Governance (“ESG”) compliance and reporting requirements that support financing arrangements, including lender ESG expectations, disclosures, and continuous improvement initiatives
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team
Improve systems, controls, and processes to support operational efficiency and growth
About You
Senior finance leader with proven experience in strategic finance and executive decision support
Demonstrated experience leading and developing multidisciplinary finance teams.
Strong in banking/financier engagement, negotiations, and stakeholder management
Highly capable in financial analysis, risk management, cost control, and performance improvement
Experience implementing or improving ERP, finance and reporting systems will be highly advantageous.
Demonstrated ability to manage lender reporting, covenants, and funding requirements
Understanding of ESG frameworks and compliance (as required by lenders/financiers) and ability to embed practical reporting into business operations
Confident leader with strong communication and team development skills
Experience in shipping, logistics, ports, transport, infrastructure, or other asset-heavy industries is highly regarded
CPA/CA/CFA (or equivalent)
Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related discipline (postgraduate qualifications advantageous)
What We Offer
Executive-level role with real influence across the business
Work at the centre of PNG trade and logistics with a major coastal fleet and port operations
Attractive remuneration package for the successful applicant
Opportunity to lead improvement initiatives and help shape the company’s next chapter
Ready to take the helm?
Submit your application with a CV and brief cover letter outlining your suitability for the role to
[email protected]
.
(Bismark Maritime Limited is an equal opportunity employer. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.)
Apply

Our client is a leading organisation in Papua New Guinea’s oil and gas sector, responsible for managing and investing in strategic petroleum assets, supporting the country’s energy security and long-term economic development. With a strong focus on operational excellence, safety, and environmental stewardship, the organisation is committed to delivering major energy projects and maintaining high industry standards across its operations.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Project HSE champion to join our client's Engineering and Projects team based in Port Moresby. The successful candidate will provide leadership and oversight of all health, safety, and environmental activities throughout the construction phase of a major fuel storage facility project. This role requires a highly experienced HSE professional with strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills,
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with the Construction Management Team to promote continuous improvement in HSE performance across the project.
Ensure project personnel and contractors comply with the Project HSE Execution Plan and environmental commitments.

Promote a strong team approach to maintaining and enhancing HSE performance on site.

Strong knowledge of National Safety, Health and Environmental regulations
Minimum 10 years’ experience operating HSE management systems and processes.
Minimum 10 years’ experience within oil and gas, energy, or major construction projects.
Strong understanding of Permit to Work systems and contractor management
.
Excellent communication, presentation, planning, and organisational skills.
High level of computer literacy and reporting capability.
Ability to develop, implement and conduct HSE training and presentations

Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our Commercial team, you will assist with the co-ordination of all K92 Mining inventory aspects relating to materials. To ensure optimum cost effectiveness and timely provision of supplies. To minimize the impact of the department on the environment and ensure the workplace health & safety of employees, contractors and other stakeholders are maintained.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position mean you will
Ensure that all aspects of Category Management process are undertaken in accordance with established policy and procedures
Assist in weekly and monthly reports are run and acted upon to guarantee no stock outs in materials
Ensure the timely completion of all tasks for both staff and contractors
Ensure all daily stock takes are carried out in a timely manner and posted within 24 hours of stock count
Update Pronto with correct and accurate information in relation to cataloguing requirements.
Complete all Material data master additions and changes.
Assist in investigation of inventory discrepancies and obsolesces including relevant investigations.
Complete all ANSI requests within a timely fashion.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have the following
Minimum 2 years’ experience in industry with relevant experience
Experience with Pronto function to Support Inventory requirements.
Experience with storage and handling of Dangerous goods
Behaviour consistent with K92 Mining core values
Excellent problem solving and decision-making capability
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience communicating with vendors in PNG and internationally
Ability to communicate clearly with people at all levels of the organisation and engage all relevant stakeholders
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

27769.description:
BRING YOUR PASSION TO YOUR FUTURE WORKPLACE - JOIN OUR TEAM
DHL Express invites you to apply for the following opportunity.
National Operations Manager - PNG
We are seeking a highly skilled Operations Manager with experience in the logistics industry or a related field. This position will be based at our Head Office in Port Moresby. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing and managing the daily operational activities of the DHL Express network within Papua New Guinea. You will provide strategic leadership and direction to the Operations team, ensuring efficient and effective management of our operations.
Responsibilities will include:
Establish and uphold exceptional customer service performance indicators, striving to meet or exceed standards for on-time delivery, tracing, dispatch, and claims management, including handling missed pick-ups, ensuring scanning compliance, and maintaining overall service quality.
Take responsibility for cost optimization within the facility to enhance operational efficiency.
Manage employee and labor relations by applying relevant regulations and internal policies appropriately.
Oversee all local Human Resources matters in coordination with the Human Resources team, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Ensure the effective implementation, ongoing application, and maintenance of Track and Trace technology, which includes scanning compliance for pickups and deliveries, monitoring on-hand inventory, linking multi-piece shipments, and facilitating transfers to agents.
Monitor and enhance EBIT by driving profitable revenue growth and effectively managing pick-up and delivery costs, shipment handling, and timely data entry.
Identify and track route service standards, making operational adjustments as necessary, such as managing driver costs per shipment, stops per hour, driver load capacity, and departure times.
Organize tasks, assign responsibilities, and develop competent staff through training and counseling, providing opportunities for growth and advancement.
Provide leadership through decisive decision-making, effective communication, and motivation, fostering an environment where staff can perform their duties proficiently and qualify for advancement.
Ensure that all staff comply with established company standards, policies, and procedures, including Workplace Conduct, Occupational Health & Safety, and Transport of Dangerous Goods regulations.
Stay informed about general business conditions and activities of both current and potential competitors to remain competitive in the market.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational processes and service delivery.
Deliver outstanding customer service across Papua New Guinea by ensuring clear and effective communication, addressing customer inquiries, concerns, and requests with attentiveness and understanding.
Candidates' requirements for the role include:
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Proven experience and success in operations leadership role.
Excellent communication skills - written & verbal.
Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple tasks/priorities.
Demonstrated ability to work with Airlines and relevant Government bodies.
Demonstrated analysis & problem-solving skills.
Strong leadership capabilities and demonstrated ability to work in a culturally diverse team.
Minimum of  5 year’s working in an Operations management role.
Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree in industry relevant course.
Valid Identification Card (NID/ Birth Certificate/ Passport/ Driver’s License)
Current class 6 driver’s license
Current police clearance certificate
Join us and you'll be working for a global company that's focused on service, quality and sustainability, and using the power of global trade to connect people and improve lives. And not just for our Customers, but for every member of our Group too. As a part of DHL, you will play an important role in delivering quality services and solutions to our customers. We will support you in expanding your knowledge and personal and professional growth, always keeping in mind that life outside the workplace is just as stimulating as work itself.
We will also ensure that we reward your hard work at a competitive rate.
Get ready!
If this sounds like the opportunity you’ve been dreaming of, please submit your CV together with other relevant supporting documents with the subject line
Expression of Interest – National Operations Manager
to

.

DHL Express (PNG) Limited
P O Box 1775, Port Moresby, NCD, 121
Corner Morea Tobo Road and Kittyhawk Street, 6 Mile.

July 2026 at 5.00 pm.

The Organisation:
Pacific Adventist University (PAU) is owned and operated by the South Pacific Division of the Seventh-day Adventist Church. The institution is accredited by the Adventist Accreditation Association, an international denominational authority for all tertiary and graduate educational programs and institutions owned by Seventh-day Adventist Church entities. The main campus is located on the pristine Koiari Park, 14 miles outside Port Moresby, the capital of Papua New Guinea. The institution was established in 1984. Since then, it has grown from a college of 20 students to a university of over 1000 students from across the Pacific.
The Role:
Reporting to the Farm Manager, the incumbent will support PAU’s farm operations by safely operating tractors and related machinery to ensure efficient land preparation, planting, harvesting, and general farm maintenance and is required to perform the following ‘Core Responsibilities’ listed below.
Core Responsibilities:
Operate tractors and farm machinery for ploughing, harrowing, planting, spraying, and harvesting.
Conduct routine checks, cleaning, and minor repairs to ensure machinery is in safe working condition.
Adhere to occupational health and safety standards, including proper use of protective gear.
Assist in preparing land for cultivation, irrigation, and crop rotation.
Transport farm produce, inputs, and equipment within the University farm and to designated storage areas.
Maintain accurate logs of tractor usage, fuel consumption, and maintenance schedules.
Work closely with farm staff, students, and supervisors to achieve operational goals.
About you:
Qualifications and Skills required:
Minimum of Grade 10 completion; vocational training in agriculture or mechanics is an advantage.
Valid driver’s license with tractor/machinery operation endorsement.
At least 2 years of experience operating tractors or heavy farm machinery.
Knowledge of farm machinery operation and maintenance.
Ability to follow instructions and work independently.
Strong awareness of safety protocols.

Click
https://www.pau.ac.pg/work-with-us/
to view ‘Position Description’ and ‘Application Form’. Submit a completed application form, including a cover letter setting out your relevant experience to the core responsibilities of the role, and copies of your educational qualifications in a
single file
to
[email protected]
.
As an equal opportunity employer, PAU particularly encourages applications from women.
Application closes on Friday, 24
th
July 2026

Pacific Adventist University
Private Mail Bag, Boroko, National Capital District

27874.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our exploration team, in this role you will operate LM90 Diamond Drill rigs and recover an accurate sample/core as per K92 mining specification, in a safe, cost-effective and timely manner.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Management of the diamond drill tooling, inventory and all related machinery and equipment.
Diagnose down hole problems and remedy issues that may arise.
Ensure survey data is being recorded and reported correctly and in a timely manner.
Ensure diamond drill core recovery is maximised and displayed correctly.
Ensure record keeping is completed correctly and in a timely manner for drill reports, consumables and any other requirements as identified.
Ensure effective processes for communicating relevant information, including company, site, department, and team performance, to all team members are in place.
Direct and train employees on appropriate and effective drill practices and techniques.
Develop team members through regular feedback, coaching and formal training.
Identify skills gaps and training requirements and assist in developing training packages as required to close the skills gap.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure diamond drilling operations are conducted by competent operators in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures and legislation.
About You
To be considered for this position, it is essential that applicants have demonstrated experience in the safe operation of an LM90 Diamond Drill rig. In addition to this, applicants should also
Qualifications in Drilling Operations or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 3 years experiences drilling with LM90 and rod handler.
Possess certified Miner training certificate in area of handling hand drill machine
Basic Life Support and First Aid Certificate.
PNG National Driver’s License. (Class 6 preferred)
Knowledge of critical components of the Drills and their functions.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

27870.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our growing exploration department, you will act as the operational bridge between the geologists who plan and direct exploration programmes and the field and drilling personnel who implement them. Reporting to Superintendent Exploration, the role receives day-to-day technical instruction from programme geologists, coordinates ground-level execution with drilling supervisors and field crews, and supervises sampling, logistics and safety compliance.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Receive priorities, locations, methods, sequence and quality requirements from the responsible geologist and translate them into clear daily field tasks.
Coordinate daily interfaces among geologists, drilling supervisors, survey, contractors, Senior Field Assistants and field crews.
Monitor work against approved plans, report progress and variances, and obtain geological direction before changing scope, location or technical method.
Prepare crew allocations, rosters, access, communications, equipment, consumables and daily field reports.
Coordinate drill-site readiness, including access, collar pegging, pad and sump preparation, drainage, water, lighting, sample areas, environmental controls and rehabilitation.
Liaise with geology, survey and the drilling supervisor during rig moves and set-up to confirm planned collar, dip, azimuth and site requirements.
Observe drilling progress, core or sample recovery, water management, housekeeping and field safety; communicate issues to the drilling supervisor and geologist for action.
Coordinate core and drill-sample movement, metre marking, orientation support, photography, registration and secure delivery without loss, contamination or mix-up.
Check shift records, metres, downtime, consumable usage and contractor dockets for completeness before submission.
Supervise soil, stream-sediment, rock-chip, channel, trench and other sampling to the geologist's approved locations, spacing, depth and methods.
Ensure correct sample IDs, coordinates, descriptions, weights, bags, tags and seals, and maintain Chain-of-Custody through dispatch.
Verify standards, blanks, duplicates and other QA/QC samples at the required frequency; report errors and coordinate corrective or repeat work as directed by geology.
Reconcile physical samples with paper and digital registers, review dispatch documents and confirm laboratory receipt.
Coordinate mapping and survey support, including traverses, outcrop or trench preparation, photographs, measurements and accurate location records.
Lead pre-starts, toolbox meetings, Take 5/JSA activities and field inspections; reinforce required procedures and exercise stop-work authority where conditions are unsafe.
Report hazards, incidents, environmental issues and community or access concerns promptly and support corrective actions.
Maintain emergency communications, first-aid and evacuation readiness, and coordinate drills and field response arrangements.
Coordinate mobilisation, camps, vehicle or helicopter loads, fuel, water, tools, sampling supplies, communications and inventory.
Ensure equipment pre-starts, basic maintenance, defect reporting, waste control, spill prevention and progressive rehabilitation are completed.
Supervise and coach the Senior Field Assistant, Field Assistants and local labour in safe field practices, sampling quality, equipment care, reporting and work discipline.
Maintain regular communication with programme geologists and the Superintendent Exploration on progress, field conditions, risks, delays and resource needs.
Respect the separate accountabilities of geology, drilling contractors and support functions; facilitate coordination rather than assume technical control of their work.
Recommend practical improvements to field safety, logistics, sample quality, productivity and procedures.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Grade 12 education or equivalent experience; a certificate in exploration, mining, geology, safety or frontline supervision is desirable.
Current first-aid certificate and valid field-appropriate driver licence are desirable
At least 8 years of mineral exploration field experience, including experience leading field crews.
Practical experience with drilling support, drill-site logistics, core or sample handling, geochemical sampling, QA/QC and Chain-of-Custody.
Sound understanding of the separate roles of programme geologists, drilling supervisors/contractors and field support personnel.
Competence with GPS units, field records, sample registers, basic survey support, daily reporting and field equipment.
Strong field HSE, environmental and emergency-response awareness and ability to work in remote conditions.
Ability to plan and coordinate work, coach diverse crews, communicate clearly and escalate issues appropriately.
Physically and mentally fit for remote fieldwork; able to speak, read and write English. Tok Pisin or local language capability is advantageous.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply
