SPATIAL TECHNOLOGY SUPERVISOR
Job Purpose:
The Spatial Technology Supervisor is responsible for operating Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) within NBPOL, ensuring all flight activities are planned and executed in full compliance with safety and regulatory requirements. The role also includes managing data transfer and processing to deliver accurate outputs on schedule.
Main Responsibilities:
Develop annual work plans supported by monthly progress reporting.
Design, programme, and operate Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) flights.
Ensure all operations comply with safety standards and regulatory requirements set by the Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA).
Coordinate with manned aircraft operators and relevant authorities during UAV operations.
Ensure the accuracy and quality of photogrammetry and LiDAR outputs.
Deliver spatial data outputs in appropriate and usable formats.
Prepare analytical reports based on processed data.
Carry out blueprint mapping activities.
Maintain comprehensive records of all UAV flight operations.
Manage and update the asset register for all tools, equipment, and consumables.

27456.description:
Job Type:
Fixed Term Contract
A
bout us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our projects team, you will ensure the timely availability of materials from the warehouse and to carry out the receipt, storage, issue, and dispatch of materials for the project department in a safe and efficient manner whilst adhering to site policies and procedures
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Receive, store, issue and despatch of operational spares and consumables to ensure continuous production at all times.
Unpack, sort and checking of goods received for quality, quantity and specification.
Ensure all goods are issued in accordance with company procedures and discrepancies are investigated in a timely manner
Complete stock taking as directed by the Supply Superintendent and Supply Manager.
Investigate invoice discrepancies relating to receipting issues.
Support the implementation of supply process improvements.
Maintain compliance with Supply standard operating procedures (SOP’S).
Ensure Warehouse housekeeping and all activities are carried out to a standard that is conducive to ensuring an injury free workplace.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have
Demonstrated skill in the use of supply computing software.
Lower secondary School Education
Knowledge of the following software: Pronto, Microsoft office suite
Good interpersonal skills together with effective communication skills.
Demonstrated skills in risk awareness and hazard identification.
Demonstrated skills in analysis and problem solving.
Demonstrated skills in warehousing concepts and techniques.
Competence in operation of materials handling equipment. (Eg: Forklift truck).
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

ABOUT THE ROLE
To support the Senior Finance Manager in managing the organization's financial operations by ensuring accurate financial reporting, budgeting, compliance, cash flow management, and internal controls. The role assists in maintaining the financial integrity of the business while providing financial insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely completion of financial close processes.
Manage general ledger, reconciliations, cash flow, bank accounts, accounts receivable, and accounts payable to maintain financial stability.
Assist in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting to support strategic decision-making and performance improvement.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations, taxation requirements, internal controls, company policies, and audit recommendations.
Lead, mentor, and support finance team members while fostering strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Drive continuous improvement through process enhancements, system automation initiatives, and maintenance of finance policies, procedures, and data integrity standards.
REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional accounting certification (CPA, ACCA, CA, CIMA, or equivalent) is highly desirable.
Minimum 4-6 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance roles.
Demonstrated expertise in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, compliance, and financial controls.
Previous supervisory or team leadership experience, with strong knowledge of accounting standards and taxation requirements.
HOW TO APPLY
If you are passionate about pursuing a career with Moni Plus and enjoy being part of a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. We also offer competitive compensation and benefits, including health insurance, and professional development opportunities.
Please attention and submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this position to the email address below:

[email protected]
and apply now.
